review_scope: Criterion-level engineering review of previously unmapped PCI DSS 2.2.2 through 2.2.7.
assessment_policy: All decisions describe Magebean evidence capability only. Human verification remains mandatory and no decision establishes PCI DSS compliance.

requirements.criterion_summary: Vendor default accounts must be disabled or removed when unused, or have their default password changed when retained.
requirements.rationale: Magebean can inspect bounded Magento account and configuration evidence, but it cannot discover every vendor default account across operating systems, services, appliances, cloud consoles, and third-party components.
requirements.next_action: Run the PCI profile with --include-manual-review and provide schema-valid evidence; mandatory human verification remains required for every result.

requirements.criterion_summary: Primary functions with different security needs must be separated or all secured to the highest required level.
requirements.rationale: Verification requires a complete system-component inventory and architecture evidence for hosts, virtual machines, containers, and isolation controls outside a Magento repository.
requirements.next_action: Define structured infrastructure inventory and architecture evidence rather than a local scan rule.

requirements.criterion_summary: Only documented necessary services, protocols, daemons, and functions may remain enabled.
requirements.rationale: A repository cannot establish the running service inventory or business necessity for every in-scope system component.
requirements.next_action: Use host, container, cloud, and network configuration evidence with an approved required-function inventory.

requirements.criterion_summary: Any retained insecure service, protocol, or daemon requires documented business justification and implemented risk-reduction controls.
requirements.rationale: The requirement combines external system configuration with a human business-justification decision; a Magebean finding cannot establish both elements.
requirements.next_action: Collect service inventory, compensating security configuration, justification, owner, and approval evidence through an external evidence workflow.

requirements.criterion_summary: System security parameters must be configured to prevent misuse according to the configuration standard.
requirements.rationale: Production mode, disabled Xdebug, disabled error display, and disabled template hints are concrete Magento and PHP security parameters, but they cover only a subset of all in-scope components and parameters.
requirements.next_action: Add PARTIAL mappings for the four existing rules and retain mandatory review of configuration standards and remaining parameters.

requirements.criterion_summary: All non-console administrative access must use strong cryptography and insecure remote login methods must be unavailable.
requirements.rationale: Magento admin HTTPS, HSTS, and observed TLS protocol evidence cover browser administration only; they do not prove secure SSH, APIs, OOB management, or every in-scope component.
requirements.next_action: Add PARTIAL or SUPPORTING mappings for existing HTTPS/TLS rules and require external evidence for all other administrative paths.
